title: Null dereference in Necko HTTP channel during background DNS resolution timeout
description: When an HTTP connection request encounters a DNS resolution timeout while the tab is being closed, nsHttpChannel::OnStopRequest dereferences a null mDNSTask pointer causing a crash in xul.dll with EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION.
fix_patch_summary: Added explicit null check for mDNSTask before calling CompleteResolution() and ensured cancellation listener unregisters during channel abort.

title: DOM AudioContext thread deadlock during rapid media stream pause and resume
description: Calling AudioContext.suspend() and resume() rapidly across Web Audio nodes deadlocks the graph rendering thread waiting on mGraphLock mutex when audio hardware clock changes frequency.
fix_patch_summary: Refactored lock hierarchy in MediaStreamGraphImpl; replaced blocking mutex wait with non-blocking try_lock and asynchronous state queue.

title: Memory leak in Spidermonkey IonMonkey JIT compiler with recursive generator closures
description: IonMonkey optimization fails to sweep unused bytecode scope objects for nested ES6 generators, resulting in cumulative heap exhaustion under long-running Single Page Applications.
fix_patch_summary: Added explicit GC tracing hook for GeneratorScript environment objects during generational garbage collection sweep phase.

title: TLS 1.3 handshake timeout on high-latency mobile networks due to TCP window stall
description: NSS socket handshake halts indefinitely if ClientHello extension split across MSS boundaries receives out-of-order ACK on cellular interfaces.
fix_patch_summary: Configured non-blocking TCP socket timeout fallback timer (5000ms) with automatic retry using standard MSS clamping.

title: IndexedDB quota exceeded error during heavy offline cache sync without quota warning
description: IDBTransaction aborts abruptly with UnknownError / QuotaExceededException when origin storage surpasses temporary storage threshold without triggering evictor callbacks.
fix_patch_summary: Emit proactive QuotaExceededError with usage metrics before transaction failure and trigger LRU eviction asynchronously.

title: NullPointerException in KafkaProducer when send() called after metadata update failure
description: Producer metadata update failure leaves Cluster instance in partially initialized state. Subsequent record append attempts call cluster.partition() on null partition state, throwing NullPointerException in RecordAccumulator.append().
fix_patch_summary: Guard cluster.partition() call with null-safe check and propagate RetriableException to trigger metadata refresh instead of raw NPE crash.

title: Database connection pool exhaustion and socket timeout under concurrent read repair
description: Native transport connection worker pool saturates when background read repair tasks stall on unresponsive nodes. New client CQL connections time out with NoHostAvailableException / ConnectionTimeoutException after reaching max connection pool ceiling.
fix_patch_summary: Introduced dedicated bounded execution queue for read-repair messaging with drop-on-saturation policy, isolating client CQL connection listener pool.

title: SocketTimeoutException not handled during chunked HTTP/1.1 response streaming
description: When reading long chunked streams from reverse proxies, socket read timeouts cause ChunkedInputStream to leave connection socket in DIRTY state instead of releasing lease back to PoolingHttpClientConnectionManager.
fix_patch_summary: Wrapped stream consumption in try-finally block to ensure close() closes underlying socket and signals connection pool on SocketTimeoutException.

title: OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space during FST index terms dictionary construction with long terms
description: Compiling finite state transducers for terms dictionaries exceeding 10M unique tokens triggers heavy 32-bit array allocations in PositiveIntOutputs, crashing JVM with OutOfMemoryError.
fix_patch_summary: Replaced unbounded heap byte arrays with off-heap page slicing via DirectByteArrayBuffer during FST compilation phase.

title: JWT Bearer authentication filter rejects valid authorization header on header case variation
description: OAuth2 Bearer token authenticator checks Authorization header using case-sensitive lookup. Client proxies sending 'authorization' (lowercase) trigger 401 Unauthorized / TokenMissingException.
fix_patch_summary: Use case-insensitive header lookup request.getHeader('authorization') and normalize bearer token extraction prefix.

title: NullPointerException in WorkbenchPage.busyShowView when part reference is already disposed
description: Closing a dynamic editor while an async UI job attempts to reveal an associated perspective view causes busyShowView to dereference a null part pointer, throwing NPE in org.eclipse.ui.internal.WorkbenchPage.java:1289.
fix_patch_summary: Added defensive check `if (ref == null || ref.getPart(false) == null) return;` before delegating view activation to PartPane.

title: Database metadata catalog lookup deadlock in Data Tools Platform (DTP) connection thread
description: Connecting to PostgreSQL database via DTP driver causes UI freeze. Connection worker thread acquires ConnectionProfile lock while background schema reader holds CatalogLoader monitor, creating fatal AB-BA thread deadlock.
fix_patch_summary: Unified synchronization lock acquisition order across ConnectionProfile and CatalogLoader using ReentrantLock with 10s timeout.

title: OutOfMemoryError in JDT Java index manager when indexing Maven multi-module target folders
description: JavaModelManager IndexManager creates excessive JarFileIndex references without releasing file descriptors when indexing large target/classes directories, causing heap exhaustion and crash.
fix_patch_summary: Enhanced index cache eviction policy to purge closed project index buffers and exclude generated build output dirs from continuous indexing.

title: OAuth2 / JWT Token expiration in Eclipse Marketplace Client results in silent login failure
description: When an MPC session token expires after 1 hour, refreshing marketplace catalogs fails silently without prompting re-authentication or refreshing the Bearer token in secure storage.
fix_patch_summary: Intercept 401 HTTP responses in MarketplaceHttpClient, invalidate stored token, and trigger interactive re-login dialog with token refresh callback.

title: P2 repository download timeout during slow network updates leaves repository in locked state
description: ECF transport times out after 30 seconds of packet silence during artifact jar mirror download, but file lock on artifacts.xml is not released, preventing subsequent install retries.
fix_patch_summary: Added resource cleanup in finally block of FileReader.runProcessor and introduced configurable socket read timeout with resume capability.
